Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet that attributed exact dates to Britannica without opening and verifying the actual Britannica page. This is a methodological sourcing error (treating a search-engine summary as a confirmed source). Although it didn’t change the correct final conclusion (Guam occurred first), it’s the first clear mistake in the workflow.
